title: QuillBot Caps You At 125 Words - Grammarly Doesn't
description:
QuillBot's free Paraphraser caps at 125 words with just 2 of 9 modes (Premium is $8.33/mo annual). Grammarly's free plan checks grammar, spelling, and tone with no word cap, plus 100 free AI prompts (Pro is $12/mo annual). Pick by the job: rewriting long text vs. everyday writing checks. #Shorts #ai #aitools
